name: Cuddlecore
intro: For days you're not at your best, and for the long haul. Gentle food, little effort.

morning.label: a gentle start to the day

window.label: The window
window.moment: My favourite window. Whatever the weather is doing, you can watch it from here.
moments: I have watched a lot of days from here.
The glass is old, so the view wobbles a little.

microwave.label: The microwave
microwave.moment: Reheating, porridge, a mug of something warm. Quick, and no apology needed.
moments: Stir halfway and let it stand. Most things like a minute to settle.
Not glamorous. Very reliable.

air-fryer.label: The air fryer
air-fryer.moment: Crisp things for not much effort. Good for a flat day.
moments: Toast, leftovers, a handful of chips. It all comes out better than it went in.
Easier to clean than the oven, which is half the appeal.

kettle.label: The kettle
kettle.moment: It lives on the left hob. It sings when I forget it, which is often.
moments: Tea, hot water for a bottle, a quick broth. It earns its place.
Filled before I've said good morning.

little-table.label: The little table
little-table.moment: Somewhere to put a cup down. Some days that's all you need from a table.
moments: I keep a glass of water on it. Sip when you remember.
Close enough to reach from the chair without getting up.

measuring-cups.label: The measuring cups
measuring-cups.moment: Four sizes, all a bit dented. I've stopped minding.
moments: Level, not heaped. I'm strict about that.
A cup is a cup, until it's someone else's cup.

wooden-spoons.label: The wooden spoons
wooden-spoons.moment: Three spoons and one favourite. You'll know which after a few meals.
moments: Wood doesn't scratch the pans, and it doesn't get hot to hold.
The slotted one is for draining and stirring. Not for soup.

timer.label: The timer
timer.moment: I set it for everything. It remembers better than I do.
moments: A timer means you can stop watching the pot.
Set it a minute short. You can always add one.

armchair.label: The armchair
armchair.moment: It sags in exactly the right places. The blanket is still warm.
moments: Erwina thinks it's hers. I let her think so.
I have fallen asleep here more than once, mid-sentence.
On the days you can't face food, a sip is plenty. Sit, and I'll sort something small.

unwell.line: Too unwell to eat much? Sit down. Small is fine in here.
unwell.sip: A sip first. Warm water, weak tea, a little broth. Nothing else to do.
unwell.nibble: A nibble next. Toast, a cracker, a spoon of rice. Stop whenever you like.
unwell.one_pan: Feeling up to a bit more? One pan, a few steps, and I'll keep it mild.

plant.label: The plant
plant.moment: I talk to it. It seems to listen.
moments: It's doing better than I deserve.
It leans towards the window. Fair enough.

oil-lamp.label: The lamp
oil-lamp.moment: I keep it lit in the evenings. It's the light I read by.
moments: It smells faintly of warm brass.
I trim the wick myself. It's the one job I won't hand over.

cutting-board.label: Chopping board
cutting-board.moment: Knife marks from more onions than I can count.
moments: Wooden, so I oil it now and then.
It leans against the wall when it's not working. So do I.

bowl.label: The bowl
bowl.moment: My soup bowl. It's heavy, so it holds the warmth.
moments: Chipped on one side. I always turn that side away.
It does soup, cereal and the odd trifle.

basket.label: The bread basket
basket.moment: Half a loaf, wrapped in a tea towel. Help yourself.
moments: The tea towel is older than the Inn.
Tear a bit off. The crust's the best part.

feels-tray.label: How you like it
feels-tray.moment: My tray of feels. Tell me how you like things, and I'll cook to suit.

steps: Put the ginger slices in a mug and pour over the hot water.
Leave it for 3 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and the honey.
Hold it with both hands and sip slowly.

atoms.method_short: Ginger slices, a squeeze of lemon and a spoon of honey in hot water. Hold it with both hands.

seed.name: Honey, ginger and lemon drink
seed.why: Warm and gentle, and easy to sip when you're not up to much.

atoms.body: Ginger slices, a squeeze of lemon and a spoon of honey in hot water. Hold it with both hands.

atoms.body: A spoon of miso stirred into hot water, with tofu, spinach or leftover rice. Sip it slowly.

atoms.title: Buttered toast, cut into soldiers
atoms.hook: Toast in strips, with a soft egg to dip them in.
atoms.method_short: Toast counts. Cut it into strips and it feels like someone's looking after you.

seed.name: Soft-boiled egg with toast soldiers
seed.why: Plain, soft and easy to eat when your appetite is low.

atoms.title: Quick congee from leftover rice
atoms.hook: Leftover rice simmered soft in stock, with ginger on top.
atoms.method_short: Simmer leftover rice in plenty of stock until it goes soft and thick. Ginger and spring onion on top.

seed.why: Soft, warm and very easy to eat.

atoms.body: Simmer leftover rice in plenty of stock until it goes soft and thick. Ginger and spring onion on top.

atoms.title: Why warm food feels like comfort
atoms.hook: Why soft, warm, salty food is easy when your appetite is low.
atoms.method_short: Warm, soft, salty food is easy to eat when your appetite is low, and the smell does half the work. Comfort is a real thing, not a weakness.

seed.name: Simple chicken noodle soup
seed.why: Warm, salty and soft, all in one bowl.

atoms.body: Warm, soft, salty food is easy to eat when your appetite is low, and the smell does half the work. Comfort is a real thing, not a weakness.

atoms.title: Why ginger feels warming
atoms.hook: Ginger's gentle heat is a milder cousin of chilli's kick.
atoms.method_short: Ginger's gentle heat comes from gingerol, a milder cousin of the compound behind chilli's kick. That's why ginger tea warms you from the middle.

seed.name: Ginger and spring onion noodles
seed.why: A quick way to taste what ginger does in hot oil.

atoms.body: Ginger's gentle heat comes from gingerol, a milder cousin of the compound behind chilli's kick. That's why ginger tea warms you from the middle.

atoms.title: What "spoons" means
atoms.hook: The spoons on each card show how much energy it costs.
atoms.method_short: Spoon theory: some days you only have a few units of energy to spend. The spoons on each card show what it costs.

seed.name: A no-cook snack plate
seed.why: A meal that costs no spoons at all.

atoms.body: Spoon theory: some days you only have a few units of energy to spend. The spoons on each card show what it costs.

atoms.title: No-chop pantry pasta
atoms.hook: Pasta, a tin of tomatoes and dried herbs. Nothing to chop.
atoms.method_short: Pasta, a tin of tomatoes, a glug of oil and dried herbs. Nothing to chop, one pot, fifteen minutes.

seed.name: One-pot tomato pasta
seed.why: Dinner from the cupboard on a day with nothing left in the tank.

atoms.body: Pasta, a tin of tomatoes, a glug of oil and dried herbs. Nothing to chop, one pot, fifteen minutes.

atoms.title: An armchair plate
atoms.hook: Crackers, cheese, apple and a few nuts, under a blanket.
atoms.method_short: Crackers, a bit of cheese, apple slices and a few nuts. One plate, eaten under a blanket.

seed.name: Cheese and apple snack plate
seed.why: Nothing to cook and one plate to wash.

atoms.body: Crackers, a bit of cheese, apple slices and a few nuts. One plate, eaten under a blanket.

atoms.method_short: Two apples, half a cucumber and a few mint leaves through the juicer. Pour it over ice.

seed.name: Apple, cucumber and mint juice
seed.why: Cold, green and fresh on a hot day.

atoms.body: Two apples, half a cucumber and a few mint leaves through the juicer. Pour it over ice.

atoms.title: Carrot, orange and ginger juice
atoms.hook: Carrot, orange and a thumb of ginger. Bright and sharp.
atoms.method_short: Carrots, two oranges and a thumb of ginger, juiced. Bright orange and sharp.

seed.name: Carrot, orange and ginger juice
seed.why: A sharp, bright glass of juice.

atoms.body: Carrots, two oranges and a thumb of ginger, juiced. Bright orange and sharp.

atoms.title: A green smoothie that tastes nice

atoms.method_short: Spinach, a banana, a spoon of peanut butter, a few oats and milk, blended. You won't taste the spinach, honestly.

atoms.body: Spinach, a banana, a spoon of peanut butter, a few oats and milk, blended. You won't taste the spinach, honestly.

atoms.title: Watermelon with mint and lime
atoms.hook: Cold watermelon with mint, lime and a pinch of salt.
atoms.method_short: Cold watermelon, torn mint, a squeeze of lime and a pinch of salt. Eat it with your fingers.

seed.name: Watermelon, mint and lime salad
seed.why: Mostly water, very cold, and no cooking.

atoms.body: Cold watermelon, torn mint, a squeeze of lime and a pinch of salt. Eat it with your fingers.

steps: Wash the grapes and pat them dry.
Spread them on a tray and freeze for 3 hours or more.
Squeeze the lime over the top and tear over the mint.

atoms.method_short: Grapes left in the freezer for a few hours turn into little sorbet bites.

seed.name: Frozen grapes with lime
seed.why: A cold, sweet snack that asks nothing of you.

atoms.method_short: Grated cucumber, squeezed dry, stirred into thick yoghurt with garlic, mint and salt. Crackers or flatbread on the side.

atoms.body: Grated cucumber, squeezed dry, stirred into thick yoghurt with garlic, mint and salt. Crackers or flatbread on the side.

atoms.method_short: An apple in thin slices and a spoon of peanut butter to dip them in. Crunchy, sweet and salty.

atoms.method_short: Butter on the outside, plenty of cheese inside, a low pan and a bit of patience. Eat it straight from the pan.

seed.name: Cheese toastie

steps: Warm the milk in a small pan over low heat until steaming, not boiling.
Stir in the cinnamon and the honey.
Pour into a mug and sit somewhere quiet.

atoms.title: Warm milk with cinnamon

atoms.method_short: Milk warmed with a pinch of cinnamon and a little honey. Something quiet to sit with.

seed.name: Warm cinnamon and honey milk
seed.why: Something warm and quiet to sit with.

atoms.body: Milk warmed with a pinch of cinnamon and a little honey. Something quiet to sit with.

atoms.title: A quick bowl of porridge
atoms.hook: Oats stirred slowly in milk, with apple and honey on top.
atoms.method_short: Oats, milk and a pinch of salt, stirred over a low heat for five minutes. Honey or grated apple on top.

seed.name: Creamy porridge with apple and honey
seed.why: Warm, filling and easy to make.

atoms.body: Oats, milk and a pinch of salt, stirred over a low heat for five minutes. Honey or grated apple on top.

atoms.title: Tomatoes with salt and basil

atoms.method_short: Slice ripe tomatoes thickly onto a plate. Scatter torn basil and salt, and pour over a little olive oil.

seed.name: Summer tomato salad with basil
seed.why: In summer, ripe tomatoes need nothing else.

atoms.body: Slice ripe tomatoes thickly onto a plate. Scatter torn basil and salt, and pour over a little olive oil.

atoms.method_short: Scoop the flesh from four feijoas. Blend with a banana, a few spoons of yoghurt and a little honey.

atoms.method_short: Peel and chunk the kūmara, boil for fifteen minutes until soft, then mash with butter, salt and pepper.

atoms.method_short: Cover couscous with boiling water for five minutes, then fork it through with a tin of chickpeas, lemon juice, chopped herbs and oil. No pot needed.

seed.name: Couscous with chickpeas, lemon and herbs
seed.why: The kettle does the cooking, and so does the couscous.

atoms.body: Cover couscous with boiling water for five minutes, then fork it through with a tin of chickpeas, lemon juice, chopped herbs and oil. No pot needed.

atoms.title: Rice noodles with soy, sesame and peas

atoms.method_short: Cover rice vermicelli with boiling water for five minutes, then drain. Toss with soy sauce, sesame oil, spring onion and frozen peas, which thaw in the hot noodles.

seed.name: Rice noodle bowl with soy, sesame and peas
seed.why: Dinner from a kettle and a packet, and still a proper bowl.

atoms.body: Cover rice vermicelli with boiling water for five minutes, then drain. Toss with soy sauce, sesame oil, spring onion and frozen peas, which thaw in the hot noodles.

steps: Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil with the salt.
Lower the egg in on a spoon and start the timer.
Cook 6 minutes for a soft yolk or 9 for firm.
Move it straight into cold water for a minute so it peels easily.

atoms.title: Boil an egg the way you like it
atoms.hook: Lower an egg into boiling water, then let the timer do the rest.
atoms.method_short: Lower the egg into boiling water on a spoon. Six minutes for a soft yolk, nine for firm, then straight into cold water so it peels.

seed.name: Soft or hard boiled eggs
seed.why: Timing is the whole trick, and a timer does it for you.

atoms.body: Lower the egg into boiling water on a spoon. Six minutes for a soft yolk, nine for firm, then straight into cold water so it peels.

steps: Rinse the rice in a sieve until the water runs clearer.
Put the rice, water and salt in a pot with a lid and bring to the boil.
Turn it right down, put the lid on and cook for 12 minutes without lifting it.
Turn off the heat and leave it covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

atoms.title: Cook rice in a pot
atoms.hook: Rice, water and a lid. No rice cooker needed.
atoms.method_short: Rinse a cup of rice, add a cup and a half of water and bring it to the boil. Turn it right down with the lid on for twelve minutes, then leave it covered for five more.

seed.name: Plain boiled rice in a pot
seed.why: Once you can do rice, every curry and stir-fry gets easier.

atoms.body: Rinse a cup of rice, add a cup and a half of water and bring it to the boil. Turn it right down with the lid on for twelve minutes, then leave it covered for five more.

ingredients.item: timer: a phone, an oven dial or a wind-up one

steps: Set the timer when the food goes on, not when you remember.
Choose the shorter time first.
When it rings, check the food.
If it needs more, add a minute at a time and set it again.

atoms.title: Set a timer and walk away
atoms.hook: A timer remembers so you don't have to.
atoms.method_short: Set the timer when the food goes on, not when you remember. Pick the shorter time, check, then add a minute if it needs it. Your phone, the oven or a wind-up dial all do the job.

seed.name: Pasta, timed
seed.why: Most overcooking is just forgetting.

atoms.body: Set the timer when the food goes on, not when you remember. Pick the shorter time, check, then add a minute if it needs it. Your phone, the oven or a wind-up dial all do the job.

ingredients.item: lemon, or a drop of vinegar

steps: Taste the food before you add anything.
Add a small pinch of salt, stir, and taste again.
If it still seems flat, add a squeeze of lemon or a drop of vinegar.
Add pepper last.
Use a clean spoon each time you taste.

atoms.title: Season to taste
atoms.hook: A pinch, a stir, a taste. Repeat until it's right.
atoms.method_short: Taste before you season, add a small pinch of salt, stir and taste again. If it still seems flat, try a squeeze of lemon or a drop of vinegar before more salt. Use a clean spoon each time.

seed.name: A pot of soup, seasoned as you go
seed.why: Small steps are how you stop it going wrong.

atoms.body: Taste before you season, add a small pinch of salt, stir and taste again. If it still seems flat, try a squeeze of lemon or a drop of vinegar before more salt. Use a clean spoon each time.

ingredients.item: set of measuring spoons or cups
kitchen scale, if you have one

steps: For cups and spoons, fill, then level off the top with a knife. Don't heap.
For scales, put the bowl on first and zero it.
Weigh each ingredient straight into the bowl, zeroing between them.

atoms.title: Measure it: spoons, cups and scales
atoms.hook: Level the cup, zero the scales, and it comes out the same each time.
atoms.method_short: For cups and spoons, fill and level off with a knife, don't heap. For scales, put the bowl on first and zero it, then weigh each thing straight in.

seed.name: Plain scones, measured properly
seed.why: Baking is the one place a guess costs you.

atoms.body: For cups and spoons, fill and level off with a knife, don't heap. For scales, put the bowl on first and zero it, then weigh each thing straight in.

rain.label: Rain

fair.label: Fair
fair.moment: Fair weather. Clear skies, not a cloud about.

change.label: Change

stormy.label: Stormy
stormy.moment: Listen to that wind. Glad you're in here with me.

very-dry.label: Very Dry
very-dry.moment: Hot and dry out there. Let's keep things cool.

dawn.label: Dawn
dawn.moment: Up with the light. Kettle on, and something small to start?

morning.label: Morning
morning.moment: Morning! Something easy to start the day, I think.

evening.label: Evening
evening.moment: Evening's drawing in. Time for a proper meal?

dusk.label: Dusk
dusk.moment: The light's going gold. Lovely time for a drink and something warm.

night.label: Late night
night.moment: Burning the midnight oil? Let's keep it gentle.

burnt-out.label: Burnt out
burnt-out.moment: Running on a stub today? Let's keep it simple.

low.label: Low

half.label: Half
half.moment: Half a candle. Something easy, with a bit of care in it.

three-quarters.label: Three-quarters
three-quarters.moment: Plenty left in you today. We could make something proper.
